description: Set IPTC location fields from get_photo_metadata. Omitted fields stay, empty strings clear. GPS stays (use set_gps). Returns updated (photos written) and fields; unknown IDs are not_found. Rules: give at least one of sublocation, city, state_province, country, iso_country_code.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

sublocation.description: Sublocation: a venue, landmark or neighbourhood (e.g. 'Sydney Opera House')

name: set_location
title: Set location
